name: za.co.getestimated/sa-estimate
title: GetEstimatED — South African building cost estimates
description: South African building costs: rates, material price index, quick estimates, quote checks, BOQs

tools.name: sa_building_rate_lookup
tools.description: Approximate all-in South African building rate for an item of work (materials + labour + plant + contractor margin, excl. VAT) per unit, e.g. "230 mm brick wall" per m², "concrete strip footing" per m³, "IBR roof sheeting" per m², "ceramic floor tiles" per m². Adjusted for the province and, for finish items, the quality class. From GetEstimatED's own rate guide 2026 — a guide for budgeting, not a quotation.

item.description: The work item in plain words, e.g. "plaster to internal walls" or "concrete surface bed 100 mm".

province.description: Province: GP, WC, KZN, EC, FS, LP, MP, NW, NC (or the province name). Default Gauteng.

quality.description: Quality class of finishes: economic, standard, middle, luxury, exclusive, super_luxury. Default standard.

tools.name: sa_material_price_index
tools.description: Indicative South African retail price of a building material (cement, bricks, sand, timber, roof sheeting, ceiling board, paint, tiles, sanitaryware …): the median price per unit incl. VAT, the month and how many products it is based on — for one province, or for all nine provinces side by side (province "all"). An industry pricing indicator, not a quote from a supplier.

material.description: The material, e.g. "cement 50 kg", "face bricks", "IBR sheeting", "river sand".

province.description: Province: GP, WC, KZN, EC, FS, LP, MP, NW, NC (or the province name), or "all" to compare the nine provinces. Default Gauteng.

tools.name: sa_quick_estimate
tools.description: Ballpark cost to build a house (or an addition) in South Africa from its floor area: low, expected and high in rand, excl. and incl. VAT, from the published rate per m² for the quality class (AECOM Africa Property & Construction Cost Guide 2025/26, private dwelling houses) adjusted for the province. Excludes site works, professional fees, municipal fees and escalation. A first budget figure — a bill of quantities priced for the actual plans is needed for a reliable price.

floor_area_m2.description: Gross floor area in m² (for an addition: the NEW floor area only).

quality.description: Quality class of finishes: economic, standard, middle, luxury, exclusive, super_luxury. Default standard.

province.description: Province: GP, WC, KZN, EC, FS, LP, MP, NW, NC (or the province name). Default Gauteng.

scope.description: A new house (default) or an addition / alteration to an existing house.

tools.name: sa_check_quote
tools.description: Checks the line rates in a South African building or repair quote against GetEstimatED's rate guide: each recognised line is marked below, in or above the usual range for the province and quality class, with the guide rate, and the recognised lines are totalled. Useful to homeowners, architects, brokers and assessors before accepting a quote. Lines it cannot recognise are listed, not guessed.

description.description: Line description as on the quote.

unit.description: Unit: m², m³, m, No, kg, item …

quantity.description: Quantity (needed when only an amount is given).

amount.description: Line amount in rand (used with quantity when there is no rate).

province.description: Province: GP, WC, KZN, EC, FS, LP, MP, NW, NC (or the province name). Default Gauteng.

quality.description: Quality class of finishes: economic, standard, middle, luxury, exclusive, super_luxury. Default standard.

prices_include_vat.description: True if the quote's rates include VAT (default false).

tools.name: list_my_projects
tools.description: Lists the projects in the user's own GetEstimatED account with each project's latest estimate (status, total incl. VAT when ready) and the estimate credits left. Use it first to find a project_id. Read-only. Needs the user's GetEstimatED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

limit.description: How many projects, newest first (default 20, max 50).

tools.name: get_my_bill
tools.description: Returns one of the user's own estimates (bill of quantities made by Estie): totals excl./incl. VAT with the likely range, contingency, the value per trade, how much of it is priced, and links to download the PDF and Excel (valid 24 hours). If the estimate is still being made it says so — ask again in a minute. Read-only. Needs the user's GetEstimatED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

bill_id.description: Optional: a specific estimate (bill of quantities) id of that project; default = the latest one.

tools.name: compare_bill_to_quote
tools.description: Compares a builder's or subcontractor's quote, line by line, with the user's OWN estimate for that project: each quote line is matched to the closest item of the same unit in the estimate and marked below / in line / above (in line = 20% below to 25% above the estimate's rate). Lines without a match, and lump sums, are listed, not guessed. Read-only. Needs the user's GetEstimatED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

bill_id.description: Optional: a specific estimate (bill of quantities) id of that project; default = the latest one.

description.description: Line description as on the quote.

unit.description: Unit: m², m³, m, No, kg, item …

amount.description: Line amount in rand (used with quantity when there is no rate).

prices_include_vat.description: True if the quote prices include VAT (the estimate's rates exclude VAT). Default false.

tools.name: estimate_from_brief
tools.description: Makes a new early-stage cost estimate (a priced bill of quantities by Estie, GetEstimatED's estimator) from a written brief — no drawings needed — in a new project in the user's own account. TWO STEPS: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview (what will be priced, province, quality class, and whether it uses one of their estimate credits — Pro accounts are unlimited) plus a confirm_token; only after the user agrees, call again with exactly the same arguments plus confirm_token (valid 10 minutes, single use). The estimate takes a few minutes: the second call returns the project_id — then call get_my_bill to fetch the totals and the PDF / Excel links. Without credits it explains how to buy a pack (buy_estimate_pack). Provinces: GP, WC, KZN, EC, FS, LP, MP, NW, NC (or the province name). Quality classes: economic, standard, middle, luxury, exclusive, super_luxury. Needs the user's GetEstimatED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

brief.description: The brief in plain words: what is being built, rooms, finishes, roof, walls, anything special (20–2000 characters).

gfa_m2.description: Approximate gross floor area in m² (required).

province.description: Province of the site: GP, WC, KZN, EC, FS, LP, MP, NW, NC (or the province name). Default Gauteng.

quality.description: Quality class: economic, standard, middle, luxury, exclusive, super_luxury. Default standard.

town.description: Town or suburb (optional, kept on the project).

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the confirm_token from the preview, after the user agreed.

tools.name: buy_estimate_pack
tools.description: Buys estimate credits for the user's GetEstimatED account: pack_10 = 10 AI estimates for R399, pack_1 = 1 AI estimate for R49 (once-off, VAT included, South African rand). TWO STEPS: the first call returns the price and what they get plus a confirm_token; after the user agrees, the second call (same arguments + confirm_token) returns a secure Paystack payment link for the user to open and pay. The credits are added as soon as Paystack confirms the payment, and a tax invoice is emailed. GetEstimatED Pro accounts do not need packs (unlimited). Needs the user's GetEstimatED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

pack.description: pack_10 (10 estimates, R399) or pack_1 (1 estimate, R49).

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the confirm_token from the preview, after the user agreed.
